title: Little Boy in Gingham Overalls on Boat Ride, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot of a smiling young boy with a blonde crew cut, wearing checkered gingham bib overalls. He is sitting outdoors on a boat or vintage ride vehicle, supported by an adult sitting next to him. In the background, a woman wearing stylish mid-century sunglasses sits under the sun. The photo reflects typical mid-century American family leisure and summer outings.
